name: Spell crafting (Codex)
author: Wizard
summary: Characters learn new spells by combining spells they already know, from recipes in the Codex.

approval.label: Who approves a crafted spell
approval.help: dm: the DM approves each one; auto: learned at once when the recipe fits.

rules.text: A character can learn a new spell by combining spells they already know, following a recipe in the Codex.
